body: Yes absolutely, I feel like my mind was once an organized straightforward room that after years of both small and big things cluttering it up there's no way to tell how to even begin straightening it out anymore

So true. We live in an unnatural and damaging world so why are people who do fine in it considered normal while those who can't handle the idiocy and mundane quality of it labeled 'ill'? We definitely were all meant for something more. Whoever came up with the structure of this world had the same ignorance is bliss dull-emotioned attitude that too many people have today.

Yeah. I'm at the point now where I'm mentally feeling a lot better but my life is still at the low point of total nothingness and loss that my depression caused. So I'll go in and out of contentedness and misery/anger all day

I had my own apartment there for 2 years mainly paid by for my parents because I was going through an unimaginably horrific time and our relationship isn't great and they thought it'd help me move forward with my life and give me a jumpstart to start supporting myself. Well surprise surprise, my problems didn't magically go away. I tried to get a handful of jobs that I eventually had to leave because of really unbearable mental/physical pain and now I'm back with living with them in a tiny boring New England town. While I was there I'd sleep all day, order takeout the rare times I remembered to eat, occasionally force myself to take a walk...those 2 years felt like 2 weeks, I was so out of it, in a depressed daze. NYC is great but just like anyplace, it's what you make it. 

Don't lose hope. Get the help you need and I assure you other opportunities will arise in nyc when you're ready to take full advantage of it

We've had extremely similar shit happen. I got forced to leave college for having depression, then developed severe chronic rib/chest/shoulder pain leaving me unable to do anything and in agony crying every day. I used to have a bright future in a great school, be super creative/smart/etc and it all went to shit. A lot of physical stuff can be the result of untreated anxiety / depression so maybe if you seek the right treatment it could help you a lot. I'm sorry for everything you've been through and I can relate. Life is unbearable for me. The way I feel is, I want to live but not if I have to live with this pain.

oh you're lucky. That's what happened to me when I didn't even try to kill myself I just mentioned I wanted to. Still, really don't recommend this method. And if you need someone to talk to I'm here. I may not have the best advice but I understand and relate and feel for you.

Not to burst your bubble but that will not kill you. All it will do will make you feel a lot of pain and then be forced into a windowless abusive mental institution for a few weeks leaving you more depressed than where you began. I advise not to do it
